preconditions.description: The number of gifts n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The pleasantness list a has exactly n elements, each between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The edges list has exactly n-1 entries, each representing a valid undirected connection between two distinct gifts.

preconditions.expression: all(1 in connected_component(edges, u) for u in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: The tree is rooted at gift 1, meaning all gifts are reachable from gift 1 via the edges.

postconditions.description: If no valid pair of gifts exists, output 'Impossible'. Otherwise, output the maximum possible sum of pleasantness for two non-overlapping subtrees.

postconditions.expression: max_sum == max(sum_subtree(a, tree, root1) + sum_subtree(a, tree, root2) for root1 in range(1, n + 1) for root2 in range(1, n + 1) if root1 != root2 and not overlap_subtrees(tree, root1, root2)) if any(root1 != root2 and not overlap_subtrees(tree, root1, root2) for root1 in range(1, n + 1) for root2 in range(1, n + 1)) else None
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum sum of pleasantness of two non-overlapping subtrees rooted at distinct gifts. If no such pair exists, output 'Impossible'.
